title: 建築拆除材料分選
titleEn: Sorting of construction and demolition materials
summary: 以「拆除前盤點、選擇性拆解與多物料品質追蹤」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow pre-demolition inventory, selective dismantling and multi-material traceability through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 拆除前材料清冊：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pre-demolition material inventory: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 拆除前材料清冊 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pre-demolition material inventory and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先盤點構件、材料、狀況與可再使用性，保留完整構件可能比破碎後回收更有價值。
steps.instructionEn: Inventory components, materials, condition and reusability; retaining components may preserve more value than crushing.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：recoverable volume=area*thickness;200*0.15；計算 200*0.15 = 30 m3。適用限制：假想板體幾何量，未扣孔洞與鋼筋。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: recoverable volume=area*thickness;200*0.15; calculation 200*0.15 = 30 m3. Applicability: Hypothetical slab geometry, without void/rebar deductions.
steps.failure: 圖面與現況不符會使車次與暫存估算失真。
steps.failureEn: Drawing/site differences distort haul and storage estimates.
steps.check: 以圖面估算並用現場量測修正孔洞。
steps.checkEn: Estimate from drawings and correct openings with field measurements.

knowledge.text: 在「拆除前材料清冊」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「圖面與現況不符會使車次與暫存估算失真。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。

Contrast the fault scenario "Drawing/site differences distort haul and storage estimates." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「建築拆除材料分選」的「拆除前材料清冊：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「資源循環物料站」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Pre-demolition material inventory: Mechanism and observation” in “Sorting of construction and demolition materials”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Circular-resource material station” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
